summary: Requires securing messages exchanged between DHCP relay agents and servers. DHCPv4 had no guidance, and DHCPv6 recommended IPsec without requiring encryption. In light of pervasive monitoring concerns, it requires securing relay-to-relay and relay-to-server traffic for DHCPv6 and relay-to-server traffic for DHCPv4.

eli5.summary: The helpers that pass address requests along should use sealed envelopes so nobody can read or change them.
